notes.title: The Newest Playback Trauma Game is Coming Soon!!
notes.content:
[b]Important Note:[/b] Purchase the Playback Trauma bundle for a 10% discount on the series!

The store page for the newest Playback Trauma game has been launched!  Instead of a beach or a highway, this time you'll be exploring a forest while looking for your lost dog Marla.  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2878640/Playback_Trauma_The_Dog/utm_source=pttb_news

This very same forest has been the bane of New Jersey residents for years, as seen here:

[previewyoutube=fijdBdu4zwI;full][/previewyoutube]


Can you find Marla and escape the forest together safely?

- Jonathan

notes.title: Added Support for Chinese and Russian Languages!
notes.content:
We're so happy to announce that with the help of some amazing translators we were able to bring all of Playback Trauma: In Sickness to new languages (~17,000 words!!).  I want to personally thank the translators responsible, without you this never would've happened:

Russian - Kateryfied
Simplified/Traditional Chinese - Horace Pan

The game has also received a permanent price reduction to $4.99 USD

I want to thank you those who have experienced Playback Trauma and continue to do so, there's so much more to come!!

- Jonathan
